com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; no purchases, watchlist edits or price changes.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: No matches return a search link and any spelling suggestion; missing search terms return a tool error. HTTP 429 includes Retry-After.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: A search summary is not a current offer lookup, private inventory report or repricing proposal.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Find public trading-card and collectibles listings by keyword.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns top-ranked titles, slugs, canonical URLs, total matches, listing counts and list-price floors in USD; unlisted catalog matches may have a labeled market value. Use the returned search-page link for more matches.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use when discovering public cards by player, set, year or product words before a product slug is known. Refine query words to narrow results; this tool returns only the first ranked page, with no cursor or page argument.
